user.description:
Identifies the {@link User} in the C3 server.
The field is populated on successful {@link SessionToken#generate} and {@link SessionToken#validate} operations.

appId.description:
Application where the {@link User} has been authenticated.
The token is valid only for this application.

expiry.description:
Represents the expiration time of the token, after which the user must re-authenticate.
It is NOT the duration of token validity.
System currently defaults to 24 hours from token generation.
Custom expiration time can be set via the claims parameter of the {@link SessionToken#generate} method.

sessionSequence.description:
The session sequence for the token. This sessionSequence is a number used for tracking
invalidated tokens for a particular user in an app.
Starts from 1, and increases with every new session created for a user in an app.
Any token issued with an earlier lower sessionSequence becomes invalid.

signedToken.description:
The signed and serialized token string.
This is what the client sends to authenticate requests to the server.

verifySessionSequence.description: If true, enforces validation on sessionSequence to ensure older tokens are invalid.

actionId.description: The {@link Action#id} when the sessionToken is generated for an action rather than standard user session flows.

title:
A SessionToken represents an authenticated user in the C3 platform.
It is generated as a result of a valid Authentication operation through one of the configured Identity Providers.
It carries information about which user is authenticated, the application context, and the token’s expiration.
name: SessionToken
